h: Mr Eazi says he turned down a Chelsea offer before Mikel Obi joined the club
p: Singer and entrepreneur Mr Eazi has reportedly said, in a video, that he rejected an offer connected to Chelsea before Mikel Obi signed for the English club. The remark has drawn fresh attention from music and football fans online.
more: Mikel Obi went on to become one of the best-known Nigerians in the Premier League.
Mr Eazi has often spoken about his love of football.
Fans have been trading reactions on social media.
